mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (i.e., the signal fails to predict negative returns 60% of the time).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts and retail sales above their 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand momentum, driving positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above 12-month moving averages, SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production above 100 indicates sustained economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods identified as 'late-cycle expansion', INDPRO is above 100 but SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts consistently signals expanding consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST trend remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment and declining unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is above 12-month MA and UNRATE is below 4.0%, SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising interest rates suppress economic activity and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods identified as 'monetary tightening cycle', FEDFUNDS is rising but SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of cases.
